Global (All).title: Taiwan President Visits US Amid Tensions
Global (All).summary: China has condemned a planned visit by Taiwan’s President to the United States, which could trigger Beijing’s retaliation measures.

Global (All).title: Iran Protests Against Government Crackdown
Global (All).summary: Protests against the Iranian government have continued, with reports of security forces cracking down on demonstrators.

Global (All).title: European Union Introduces Economic Sanctions Against Russia
Global (All).summary: The European Union has introduced new economic sanctions against Russia in response to the ongoing conflict in Ukraine.

South Korea.title: North Korea's COVID-19 outbreak raises concerns for regional security
South Korea.summary: North Korea's COVID-19 outbreak has raised concerns for regional security, with South Korea and other countries on high alert for potential outbreaks and responses.

South Korea.title: South Korea's military drills with US amid rising tensions with North Korea
South Korea.summary: South Korea and the US have conducted military drills, raising concerns about the escalating tensions between the two countries and potential military responses from North Korea.

South Korea.title: Protest in Seoul over government's handling of economy
South Korea.summary: Thousands of protesters took to the streets in Seoul to express dissatisfaction with the government's handling of the economy, highlighting growing social and economic concerns in South Korea.

Japan.title: Tokyo Olympics Organizers Apologize After 3 Athletes Test Positive for COVID-19
Japan.summary: The head of the Tokyo Olympics organizing committee has apologized after three athletes tested positive for COVID-19. The athletes are not from Japan and the source of the infection is unknown.

Japan.title: Japan's Government Warns of Rising COVID-19 Cases Amid 5th Wave
Japan.summary: The Japanese government has warned of a potential 5th wave of COVID-19 cases, as the number of new infections continues to rise. The government has asked citizens to stay vigilant and follow public health guidelines.

Japan.title: North Korea Fires Ballistic Missile into Sea of Japan, South Korea Says
Japan.summary: North Korea has fired a ballistic missile into the Sea of Japan, prompting a response from South Korea. The missile was reportedly a short-range ballistic missile, and the US and South Korea have condemned the launch.
